journalEntries.text: I feel overwhelmed with work pressure and can't seem to find balance. My thoughts keep racing about deadlines and I'm having trouble sleeping.
Today I realized I've been avoiding difficult conversations with my partner. I think I'm afraid of conflict but I know this isn't healthy.
I've been making progress with my meditation practice. I can actually sit still for 20 minutes now and feel more centered throughout the day.
Money stress is keeping me up at night. I know I need to face my financial situation but I keep procrastinating on budgeting.
I had a breakthrough in therapy today. I finally understood why I struggle with self-worth. It connects back to childhood experiences I hadn't processed.
